page_title: KOL 3-4 EIN | FC Koln v Eintracht Frankfurt 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+8' Florian Badstubner blows for a foul after Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+6' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+5' No offside! Referee Florian Badstubner points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the FC Koln players.
90+5' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The FC Koln players aren’t happy.

90+4' 3 - 4 Said El Mala sends a superb cross into the box. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the right post, leaving Michael Zetterer beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:4.
90+3' Nathaniel Brown goes off the pitch and Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
90+2' Post! Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) is repeatedly being caught offside.

87' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Michael Zetterer pulls off a brilliant save. Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
85' Fouls committed – 4:4.
84' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Ritsu Doan is replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt).

83' 2 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Isak Johannesson has a shot blocked, but the ball falls to Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) who finds some space inside the box and buries the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:4.
82' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
81' Substitution. Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) has come on for Sebastian Sebulonsen.
81' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
80' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
79' The attendance is 50000.
78' Substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud is replaced by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt).
78' Today's match ends for Jonathan Burkardt who will be replaced by Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ansgar Knauff leaves the pitch and Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
76' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a change. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) replaces Denis Huseinbasic.
76' Substitution. Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) in, Ragnar Ache out.
75' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' A pass from Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Michael Zetterer and the move breaks down.
70' 6:9 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 2:7.
68' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) attempts to find Ragnar Ache, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
66' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

66' That's unlucky! Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. FC Koln earn a corner.
63' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) is substituted due to injury. Lukas Kwasniok gives a chance to Florian Kainz.
63' The game has come to an end for Jan Thielmann. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).

63' 1 - 4 Goal! Ansgar Knauff displays great vision and sends a pass to Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:4.
61' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) looks like he won’t be able to continue.

59' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt). Ritsu Doan plays a fantastic through ball and finds Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 1:3.

55' Poor effort! The corner picks out Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
55' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Half-chance! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Marvin Schwabe reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
48' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.

46' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Michael Zetterer pulls off a brilliant save.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+6' 1 - 2 Fares Chaibi fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box. He releases a quick shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 1:2.
45+3' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
45+2' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' A player from Eintracht Frankfurt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
44' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) is penalised for holding. Florian Badstubner signals a set piece. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick.
43' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

41' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
41' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
39' 1 - 1 Gooal! Fares Chaibi takes over corner duties. Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 1:1.
39' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the corner.
38' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner kick.
36' FC Koln are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
35' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

34' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
31' The total number of attempts is 2:2. 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
30' The corner from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared away by the defence.

30' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Marvin Schwabe, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee blows his whistle, Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
28' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) evades his marker in the box and connects beautifully with the corner from Isak Johannesson. Unfortunately for him, the ball just zips a few inches past the right post.
28' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) prepares to take a corner kick.

28' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. FC Koln force their opponents to concede a corner.
26' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is able to continue to play.
25' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' Half-chance! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Marvin Schwabe reacts well to snuff out the attack.
20' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
17' 29:71 – the ratio of ball possession.

16' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
11' The players claim that Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
8' The foul by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) was seen by Florian Badstubner who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

6' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Florian Badstubner signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The FC Koln players celebrate. Goal! Ragnar Ache displays great vision and sends a pass to Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top right corner. The score is 1:0.
5' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Florian Badstubner is going to take a look using VAR.
4' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) has a goal ruled out for offside!
4' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but Marvin Schwabe comes off his line to gather the ball.

2' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Marvin Schwabe with a brilliant diving save!
2' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michael Zetterer, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Florian Badstubner.
